title: the DMZ Rising
author: Lior Zhou
blurb: Orsen Galloway, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, has spent five years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
